why: I checked all six expect lines and their proofs. Every one can be checked at the PR head. Four are CLI runs whose exit codes and exact output are confirmed with `od -c` and PIPESTATUS. One is `npm test` plus a grep and read of test/greet.test.js. The last is a read of docs/index.md "at the PR head". Each line has a clear pass or fail answer, such as exactly `HELLO, ADA!\n` with exit 0, or exit 2 with `usage: greet` on stderr. The only post-merge piece is the live docs site, and it is kept out of the expect lines. The non-goals say so directly: "Checking that the live site ... shows the change. That happens only after merge". The docs line asks only that docs/index.md contain the usage and say the output is uppercase. The outcome mentions the next deploy, but no expect line depends on a deploy or a published page.
